title: Cauchy–Schwarz Inequality
subtitle: Linear Algebra · Inner product spaces
summary: The square of an inner product is bounded by the product of the norms squared.
detail:
\[ |\langle u,v\rangle|^2 \le \langle u,u\rangle\cdot\langle v,v\rangle \]

For vectors in \(\mathbb{R}^n\): \(|u\cdot v|\le|u||v|\). Equality holds iff \(u\) and \(v\) are linearly dependent. Used to prove the triangle inequality for norms, and as a foundation for correlation in statistics (\(|r|\le 1\)).
